text: The financial data shows revenue of 35,584 million, a 16.9% YoY increase, and an EBITDA margin that rose to 18.8%—up 2.3 points since FY22—while PAT grew 6.6% YoY to 4,395 million, supporting the positive narrative. Additionally, management met the only measurable guidance call and achieved the Q4FY26 EBITDA‑margin target, further confirming the numbers back the upbeat story.
